feeds.title: The Horse Magazine » Show Jumping
feeds.description: The Horse Magazine is your number-one source for Dressage, Eventing, Showjumping and Breeding. Explore our Show Jumping section for more articles on horse jumping, breeds, tips for riders and trainers and more!

feeds.title: Jumper News
feeds.description: Jumper News is the equestrian media outlet that provides showjumping results and relevant news. Stay up to date with all the latest news and updates from show jumping industry, riders and more!

feeds.title: World of Showjumping News
feeds.description: World of Showjumping began as a sketch on a piece of paper in the summer of 2010, created out of three girls' passion for the sport. Keep up to date with the latest news from show jumper horses and riders, events, tournaments and more!

feeds.title: Horse Network » Hunter Jumper
feeds.description: Horse Network is a digital publishing platform for horse people. Since launching in 2012 as the Horse Collaborative, we've quickly cultivated and connected a passionate international community of horse lovers, athletes, equine professionals, hobbyists, dreamers, and people who just think horses are cute. This is the place to learn with the pros, get news, ask questions, and help make the horse Hunter/Jumper world more connected and open.

feeds.title: Practical Horseman Magazine » Hunters
feeds.description: Learn how to boost your hunter rounds, both at horse shows and at home, by fine-tuning your position and aids with flatwork exercises and jumping gymnastics. Practical Horseman magazine is the go-to source for information on riding and training, horse care and stable management to keep you and your horse happy, confident and healthy. We are your link to the top hunter, jumper, eventing and dressage trainers and veterinarians in the sport.

feeds.title: The Plaid Horse
feeds.description: Discover fresh inspiration from the hunter-jumper world, news about your favorite horse shows, and more! The Plaid Horse is a print and digital publishing company providing exceptional coverage for the hunter/jumper/breeding disciplines at reasonable rates. We support equestrian competitors, horse fans, the general public, and suppliers to the industry through horse show and event coverage, equine articles of interest, and advertisements.

feeds.title: Jumper Nation
feeds.description: Jumper Nation provides Horse show news, results, commentary and community for hunter/jumper enthusiasts around the globe.

feeds.title: deloise in america
feeds.description: Deloise In America is discussions on the hunter/jumper industry in America.

feeds.title: Tanya Davenport Blog
feeds.description: Tanya Davenport is an author of the upcoming middle-grade mystery set in the horse world. A blog is for horse lovers! Get riding tips, equestrian news, and musings of a hunter/jumper rider.

feeds.title: Horse Illustrated » Hunter Jumper
feeds.description: Learn about the hunter horse discipline and about show jumping, how to jump your horse better, and how to ride in hunt seat style. Horse Illustrated is the magazine for people who are passionate about horses. Each issue offers advice on horse health and care, plus user-friendly training tips for both English and western riders and engaging lifestyle features for horse lovers.

feeds.title: Comly Sport Horses Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest news & updates about top sports horse shows in Texas. Articles feature horse training, hunter-jumper training ideas, tips, horse-buying tips, and more. Authored by Happy Comly, Owner & Trainer of Comly Sport Horses. Comly Sport Horses is a well-respected, small business that provides hunter-jumper show horse services in Dallas/Fort Worth and surrounding areas. We can offer you Top-Level Training and Boarding, Horse Show Jumping Experience, and Jumper Horses to Purchase.

feeds.title: M & M Hunter Jumpers Blog
feeds.description: M&M Training specializes in Hunter Jumper training and Equitation lessons. We seek to ensure your horse is healthy and happy while training and boarding with us. We accept all varieties of horses as well as students of all ages and levels of experience. Stay up to date with what's happening at our training facility, trainers insights and tips and more!

feeds.title: Horses in the South Blog » Hunter/jumper
feeds.description: Horses in the South Blog is Your Southern Source for Everything Horse.

feeds.title: Clairvaux Blog
feeds.description: Clairvaux is a full-service hunter jumper show stable in Northern Virginia for those wanting to improve competitive performance and equestrian knowledge. The blog for Clairvaux, hunter jumper show stable, in Northern Virginia with news on horse shows, riding events and more for the equestrian fan.

feeds.title: Full Cheek
feeds.description: If you love horses, and the hunter jumper world, and are over 45, you'll feel right at home here. This blog is my journey of getting back into the irons, conquering old fears, enjoying the horses, and competing once again.

feeds.title: Clear Round Blog
feeds.description: Dedicated to the showjumping enthusiast that loves the world of showjumping. You will get professional training advice as well as reviews on products. We also keep you up to date on all the latest news in the world of showjumping. Clear-Round has been created by showjumpers for showjumpers.
